title: Mapwright — Fantasy Atlas Forge
description: Grow a world from a seed, sculpt its coasts, watch rivers find the sea, then export the atlas as PNG or real SVG.
concept: Mapwright is a pocket cartography studio. Type a seed and it grows a continent with domain-warped noise, equalises the hypsometry so the sea-level dial means exactly what it says, then runs a real hydrology pass — priority-flood depression filling, 8-connected flow accumulation, orographic rainfall with a lee-side rain shadow — before naming the seas, the mountain ranges and a dozen river-mouth cities. Five brushes let you raise, lower, smooth and roughen the land while the climate and the river network re-solve on every pen lift. Four atlas styles (inked parchment, hypsometric atlas, shaded relief, contour blueprint) redraw the same world, and the map leaves as a 960x624 PNG or as a genuine vector SVG built by marching squares.
features: Seeded world generator: domain-warped fBm + ridged noise, histogram-equalised so the sea-level dial submerges exactly that fraction of the map
Real hydrology: priority-flood depression filling, 8-connected flow accumulation, lakes where basins fill, rivers that always reach the sea
Orographic climate model with windward rain and lee-side rain shadow, feeding nine biomes plus polar ice
Five terrain brushes (raise, lower, smooth, ridge, place city) with size/strength, live brush ring, and 12 levels of undo
Four atlas styles — parchment, hypsometric atlas, shaded relief, blueprint — over the same world
Procedural cartography: continent, sea and range names, river-mouth city placement, compass rose, scale bar, graticule
Export a 960x624 PNG or a true vector SVG (marching-squares coastline, contour bands, river paths, live text labels)
Share link encodes seed, dials, style and every founded city; localStorage keeps your brushwork between visits
tech: Canvas 2D ImageData raster + vector overlay compositing
Seeded Perlin gradient noise with domain warping and ridged fBm
Priority-flood (binary heap) depression filling + flow accumulation
Histogram equalisation for hypsometry and rainfall normalisation
Marching squares contour extraction with segment linking, reused for canvas ink and SVG paths
Pointer Events, Blob downloads (PNG + SVG), URL-hash sharing, localStorage

interaction.mouse: Hover with Inspect to read biome, elevation, rainfall and temperature; drag a terrain brush to sculpt the land.
interaction.click: Pick a style or tool, drag the world dials, or use Place city to found (or remove) a named settlement.
interaction.touch: All brushes, dials and toggles are touch-driven; the map sits above a scrolling control sheet on phones.
interaction.keyboard: 1-6 tools, [ ] brush size, S cycles style, R reseeds the world, Z undoes, L toggles place names.
